userStories.title: Show gate-open counts in status cost and run detail views
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Carry the gate-open count through the last-run cost report and show positive counts in both named human-readable run views.

**Motivation** — `nax status --cost` shows e.g. `completed 1 / total 2 / failed 0` for a run where one story closed gate-open, and gives no explanation for the missing story.

**Approach** — **Gate-open in `nax status --cost` (`packages/nax/src/metrics/report.ts`, `packages/nax/src/cli/status-cost.ts`).** `CostRunSummary` gains `storiesGateOpen: number`. `buildLastRun` sets it to `last.storiesGateOpen ?? 0`, so a record written before #2884 (no field) reports 0. The `--json` path (`emitCostReportJson` -> `toCostReport`) therefore always carries the number. `displayLastRunMetrics` adds `storiesGateOpen` to the `Last Run: <feature>` info entry's data only when the value is greater than 0, so the human-readable output of older or clean runs is unchanged.

**Gate-open in `nax runs show` (`packages/nax/src/cli/runs.ts`).** `runsShowCommand` adds `storiesGateOpen` to the `Run Summary` info entry's data when the run-summary record's `data.storiesGateOpen` is a number greater than 0. If the field is absent (older record) or 0, the entry is unchanged.

Patterns to follow: conditional log fields use the spread form already used in `displayLastRunMetrics` (`...(lastRun.errorCostUsd !== undefined ? { errorCostUsd: ... } : {})`).

**Scope** — In: modify the three existing source modules and their existing mapper/CLI tests; update the typed `FIXED_REPORT: CostReportV1` lastRun literal in `packages/nax/test/unit/cli/status-cost.test.ts` to include `storiesGateOpen: 0`, keeping its other assertions unchanged. Out: story-metric success predicates belong to US-002; plan secret-shape scanning and warnings belong to US-003. Gate-open is not added to `nax status` feature views, `nax runs list`, or the aggregate `CostAggregate`; #2885 names only `nax status --cost` last-run and `nax runs show`. Existing saved `metrics.json` records are not rewritten; a gate-open story saved as a success before this feature stays as saved.

**Interface** — `CostRunSummary` (`packages/nax/src/metrics/report.ts:39`). Baseline: `{ runId, feature, startedAt, completedAt, durationMs, totalStories, storiesCompleted, storiesFailed, totalCost, avgCostPerStory, stories }`. Target: the same plus `storiesGateOpen: number`.

```typescript
storiesGateOpen: number;
buildLastRun(runs: RunMetrics[]): CostRunSummary | null
displayLastRunMetrics(workdir: string): Promise<void>
runsShowCommand(options: RunsShowOptions): Promise<void>
```

`buildLastRun` remains file-local. Read the existing `RunMetrics.storiesGateOpen?: number` and `findRunSummary(entries)` result; do not change the producers.

**Failure handling** — A `RunMetrics` record with no `storiesGateOpen` (written before #2884): `CostRunSummary.storiesGateOpen` is 0; the `Last Run` entry has no `storiesGateOpen` key. A run-summary record with no `storiesGateOpen`: `nax runs show` prints the `Run Summary` entry without the key.

**Testing** — Write failing behavioral regressions first in the existing report, status-cost, and runs suites, using captured log data to distinguish an absent key from a zero or undefined value and preserving the run-summary fixture's decoy completion logs. Verify the real mapper's additive JSON field through the existing emit path; create no new files.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] toCostReport(runs, deps) over runs whose last RunMetrics has storiesGateOpen: 1 returns lastRun.storiesGateOpen === 1.
[unit] toCostReport(runs, deps) over runs whose last RunMetrics has no storiesGateOpen field returns lastRun.storiesGateOpen === 0.
[unit] displayLastRunMetrics(workdir) over a last run with storiesGateOpen: 1 logs the Last Run: <feature> info entry with data.storiesGateOpen === 1.
[unit] displayLastRunMetrics(workdir) over a last run with storiesGateOpen: 0 logs the Last Run: <feature> entry with no storiesGateOpen key in its data.
[unit] displayLastRunMetrics(workdir) over a last run with no storiesGateOpen field logs the Last Run: <feature> entry with no storiesGateOpen key in its data.
[unit] runsShowCommand over a run log whose run-summary record carries data.storiesGateOpen: 2 logs the Run Summary info entry with data.storiesGateOpen === 2.
[unit] runsShowCommand over a run log whose run-summary record carries data.storiesGateOpen: 0 logs the Run Summary entry with no storiesGateOpen key in its data.
[unit] runsShowCommand over a run log whose run-summary record has no storiesGateOpen field logs the Run Summary entry with no storiesGateOpen key in its data.

routing.reasoning: Three existing production modules receive additive mapping and conditional logging changes using standard patterns; existing unit tests cover the consumers and legacy-record compatibility.

suggestedCriteria: When emitCostReportJson uses the real mapper over a last run with storiesGateOpen: 1, JSON.parse of stdout has lastRun.storiesGateOpen === 1.
When runsShowCommand reads a run-summary record with data.storiesGateOpen: "2", the Run Summary data has no storiesGateOpen key.

modifiedFiles.reason: the typed fixture `FIXED_REPORT: CostReportV1` builds a `lastRun` literal without `storiesGateOpen`, which no longer compiles under `bun run typecheck` once `CostRunSummary.storiesGateOpen` is required; the literal gains `storiesGateOpen: 0` and its other assertions stay unchanged.

userStories.title: Exclude gate-open workflow outcomes from story success metrics
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make newly collected single-story metrics report gate-open workflow closure as neither success nor first-pass success.

**Motivation** — In workflow mode `workflowStage` always sets `ctx.agentResult.success: true` (`workflow/stage.ts:79`), including when the story closed `complete-gate-open`.

**Approach** — **Story-metric success from the workflow end state (`packages/nax/src/metrics/tracker.ts`).** `collectStoryMetrics` computes `const gateOpen = ctx.workflowEndState === "complete-gate-open"`. Then `success` is `agentResult?.success === true && !gateOpen`, and `firstPassSuccess` adds the same `!gateOpen` term to its existing escalation-free and prior-failure-free terms. `complete` and `complete-with-rulings` still count as success. When `workflowEndState` is undefined (a pipeline-mode story), the old `agentResult` rule holds. The aggregator needs no change: `firstPassRate` and `modelEfficiency.passRate` read these two fields. Other readers of the saved fields change behaviour for a gate-open story as an intended consequence, with no code change: `context/engine/providers/prior-run-failure.ts:91` now lists its attempts as a prior failure in later runs, `metrics/aggregator.ts:243` can add it to `exhaustedStories` when its last swap hop was an availability failure, `replay/reconstruct.ts:105` copies `success: false`, and `routing/calibrate/band-stats.ts:42` no longer counts it as first-pass.

**Scope** — In: change the single-story collector's two success predicates and extend existing collector/completion regressions, including an aggregate computed from real collected story metrics. Existing `tracker.test.ts` fixtures leave `workflowEndState` unset, so they keep the old `agentResult` rule. Out: report/view counts belong to US-001; secret-shape detection and warning changes belong to US-003. The batch story-metrics path (`collectBatchMetrics`, `success: true` for every batch story) is not changed: batching is pipeline mode only (`workflowStage` throws `WORKFLOW_BATCH_UNREACHABLE` on a batch), and pipeline mode is frozen. Existing saved `metrics.json` records are not rewritten; a gate-open story saved as a success before this feature stays as saved. Do not change workflowStage's agent result, PRD passed-state persistence, completion events, downstream readers, or the aggregator implementation.

**Interface** —
```typescript
collectStoryMetrics(ctx: PipelineContext, storyStartTime: string): Promise<StoryMetrics>
```

Symbols this feature only reads: `PipelineContext.workflowEndState?: StoryState` (`packages/nax/src/pipeline/types.ts:57`); `WorkflowEndState = "complete" | "complete-with-rulings" | "complete-gate-open"` (`packages/nax/src/workflow/types.ts:36`).

**Failure handling** — `ctx.workflowEndState` undefined (pipeline mode): `success` and `firstPassSuccess` follow the old `agentResult` rule. Retain escalation and prior-failure exclusions in that old first-pass rule; a non-gate-open state is not by itself proof of agent success.

**Testing** — Write failing regressions before changing the predicates. Exercise complete-gate-open, complete, complete-with-rulings, and undefined end states with a successful agent. Build the two aggregate inputs through collectStoryMetrics rather than fabricating boolean fields, then assert firstPassRate 0.5. Extend the existing single-story completion context to verify the stored metric is false without changing its passed PRD status or gate-open reporting behavior. Reuse test helpers and preserve cost/token/fallback/escalation regressions; create no new files.
acceptanceCriteria: [unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true and ctx.workflowEndState: "complete-gate-open" returns success === false.
[unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true, ctx.workflowEndState: "complete-gate-open", no escalations and no prior failures returns firstPassSuccess === false.
[unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true, ctx.workflowEndState: "complete", no escalations and no prior failures returns success === true.
[unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true, ctx.workflowEndState: "complete", no escalations and no prior failures returns firstPassSuccess === true.
[unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true, ctx.workflowEndState: "complete-with-rulings", no escalations and no prior failures returns success === true.
[unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true, ctx.workflowEndState: "complete-with-rulings", no escalations and no prior failures returns firstPassSuccess === true.
[unit] collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) with ctx.agentResult.success: true and ctx.workflowEndState undefined returns success === true.

[unit] calculateAggregateMetrics over one run whose two stories were built by collectStoryMetrics, one with workflowEndState: "complete" and one with "complete-gate-open" (both agentResult.success: true, no escalations), returns firstPassRate === 0.5.
[unit] completionStage.execute(ctx) on a single-story context with ctx.agentResult.success: true and ctx.workflowEndState: "complete-gate-open" leaves ctx.storyMetrics[0].success === false.

[unit] When ctx.workflowEndState is undefined, collectStoryMetrics(ctx, start) returns firstPassSuccess equal to (ctx.agentResult?.success === true && (ctx.story.escalations?.length ?? 0) === 0 && (ctx.story.priorFailures?.length ?? 0) === 0), preserving the old pipeline-mode rule.

routing.reasoning: A localized predicate correction in one production module uses an existing end-state field; existing collector and completion fixtures verify propagation without changing downstream implementations.

suggestedCriteria: When calculateAggregateMetrics receives one run with two same-model, one-attempt stories collected from successful agents, one complete and one complete-gate-open, modelEfficiency for that model has passRate === 0.5.
When collectStoryMetrics receives agentResult.success: false and workflowEndState: "complete-with-rulings", it returns success === false.
When collectStoryMetrics receives a successful agent, workflowEndState: "complete", and at least one prior failure, it returns firstPassSuccess === false.

[unit] findPrdSecretShapes over a story whose title holds ghp_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa returns [{ storyId, field: "title", kind: "github" }].
[unit] findPrdSecretShapes over a story whose fourth acceptance criterion holds sk-aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa returns [{ storyId, field: "acceptanceCriteria[3]", kind: "openai" }].

routing.reasoning: Two existing source modules change deterministic matching and logging with no new abstractions. Credential/token detection and safe diagnostics trigger the mandatory security override to strict three-session TDD.

suggestedCriteria: When a story description contains only Authorization: Basic dXNlcjpwYXNz, findPrdSecretShapes returns an empty array.
When a story description contains only Cookie: session=abcdef123456, findPrdSecretShapes returns an empty array.
When a story description contains only postgres://admin:s3cret@db.internal/prod, findPrdSecretShapes returns an empty array.
When finalizeAndWritePrd scans a scoped plan whose only provider-format key is on an excluded story, it logs no PRD story text has secret shapes warning.
When finalizeAndWritePrd scans a criterion containing a provider-format key, the persisted criterion retains the original text.

modifiedFiles.reason: the `toEqual` expectations list findings as `{ storyId, field }`; each finding now also carries `kind` (`"github"` for the `ghp_` value, `"openai"` for the `sk-` value), so the expected objects gain that key.

the tests expect one `PRD story text has a secret shape` warn per field; the new invariant is one `PRD story text has secret shapes` warn per plan with data `{ count, fields, kinds }`, and the test that makes `_secretShapesDeps.redactSecrets` throw is removed because `_secretShapesDeps` no longer exists (the `_persistPrdDeps.findPrdSecretShapes` throwing test still covers `PRD secret-shape scan could not run`).

analysis:
Goal and completion: close #2885 by extending the #2884 gate-open outcome into the two named run readers, correcting newly collected single-story success metrics, and replacing noisy plan-time redactor-based detection with provider-format findings and one safe summary warning. This is an enhancement to existing TypeScript/Bun code, not a new subsystem. Exactly three independent stories run in packages/nax, with no dependency edges or new files. No changes to packages/nax-agent, nax-agent-acp, or nax-ai are needed; nax-agent's patterns are read through the existing internal entry. Graph-navigation tools were unavailable in this session, so findings were verified using direct source reads and text searches at the supplied repository root.

Architecture and conventions: packages/nax is the CLI orchestrator; metrics mapping is separated from I/O and CLI logging. Follow the architecture index at docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:17 (dependency injection), :30 (testing and structured logging), and :137 (repository constraints). Use existing bun:test fixtures and dependency seams, restore overridden seams/logger state, and first demonstrate the regression against old behavior. Commands are package-scoped; never run bare bun test or bun run nax. The pipeline owns lint/typecheck/test gates. Do not run coverage inside NAX_SANDBOXED=1. This task only writes the PRD; no implementation or tests were executed during planning.

US-001 source and consumers: packages/nax/src/metrics/report.ts:39 defines the required public CostRunSummary shape; :87 exposes the pure toCostReport mapper; :118 chooses the last run and :136 constructs its curated summary. It currently omits storiesGateOpen. Add a required number to this public summary and default the optional persisted RunMetrics field with last.storiesGateOpen ?? 0. The persisted field already exists at packages/nax/src/metrics/types.ts:326. getLastRun selects the final array element, not a timestamp sort (packages/nax/src/metrics/aggregator.ts:192); preserve that selection. CostReportV1.schemaVersion is currently 1.0 (packages/nax/src/metrics/report.ts:21); this feature adds the field without redesigning/versioning the contract or changing CostAggregate. The barrel already exports the mapper and summary type (packages/nax/src/metrics/index.ts:13). packages/nax/src/cli/status-cost.ts:64 loads raw metrics for displayLastRunMetrics, :83 already invokes the mapper for avgCostPerStory, and :85 logs the Last Run entry. Its :94 conditional errorCostUsd spread is the established pattern for omitting optional human-facing fields. Add storiesGateOpen only for a positive count; absent and zero must remain absent keys rather than undefined or zero-valued keys. emitCostReportJson at :218 delegates to toCostReport at :224 and serializes the whole result, so the new numeric JSON field should flow through without a separate mapping.

US-001 run-log reader: packages/nax/src/cli/runs.ts:105 finds the run.complete entry by the totalStories payload, protecting against unrelated completion logs. runsShowCommand at :182 uses that helper and logs Run Summary at :213; add the conditional field there only when typeof data.storiesGateOpen is number and the value is greater than zero. Do not change run selection, paths, parsing, run-list presentation, or completion event generation. The existing writer already supplies the count at packages/nax/src/execution/lifecycle/run-completion-phases.ts:400, and the metrics save path supplies it at :246. Relevant tests are packages/nax/test/unit/metrics/report.test.ts:148 (last-run mapping), packages/nax/test/unit/cli/status-cost.test.ts:53 (FIXED_REPORT), :66 (its lastRun literal), :337 (captured Last Run entry), and packages/nax/test/unit/cli/runs.test.ts:21 (runLogLines), :60 (output-dir seeding), :77 (logger capture). Update the typed FIXED_REPORT.lastRun literal to storiesGateOpen: 0 without changing unrelated assertions. Extend run-log fixtures without losing the existing decoy run.complete entry. Mapper tests establish numeric default/preservation; captured logger entries establish positive/zero/absent behavior. Backward compatibility is read-time normalization only: no historical metrics or logs are migrated. The public JSON addition is intentional; clean/legacy human output remains unchanged.

US-002 defect and correct boundary: packages/nax/src/workflow/stage.ts:54 sets ctx.workflowEndState from the story loop, :71 assigns complete-gate-open on workflow errors, and :78 constructs an agentResult with success: true. That flag indicates the stage continued and must not be changed as a shortcut. Workflow batches are rejected at :30 with WORKFLOW_BATCH_UNREACHABLE. packages/nax/src/metrics/tracker.ts:260 is the single-story collection boundary; :277 currently bases firstPassSuccess on agentResult.success plus zero escalations and prior failures, and :317 currently copies success directly. Compute gateOpen from the workflow end state and exclude it from both predicates, retaining all existing escalation/prior-failure conditions, costs, tokens, attempts, timing, agent/model resolution, and fallback attribution. complete and complete-with-rulings remain successes when the agent succeeded; an unset end state retains legacy agent-result semantics. collectBatchMetrics at :355 remains unchanged.

US-002 downstream impact: packages/nax/src/pipeline/stages/completion.ts:85-89 chooses single versus batch metric collection and stores the result in ctx.storyMetrics. It subsequently marks the PRD story passed (:149); the requested change concerns saved metric success, not PRD status, completion events, execution control flow, or the workflow state machine. packages/nax/src/metrics/aggregator.ts:59 derives firstPassRate from firstPassSuccess, and :90-97 derives per-model passRate from success divided by attempts. No aggregator production change is needed; build the complete and gate-open metrics through the real collector for the 0.5 regression. Additional intended readers need no code edits: packages/nax/src/context/engine/providers/prior-run-failure.ts:91 will retain gate-open attempts as prior failures; packages/nax/src/metrics/aggregator.ts:243 may classify a failed story's last availability hop as exhausted; packages/nax/src/replay/reconstruct.ts:105 copies success into replay; packages/nax/src/routing/calibrate/band-stats.ts:42 counts first-pass results. Search also found packages/nax/src/bakeoff/pipeline-adapter.ts:34 mapping story.success to its display status, so newly collected false values naturally propagate there too. Do not compensate for these consumers or rewrite old successes. Tests: packages/nax/test/unit/metrics/tracker.test.ts:89 provides makeCtx with a successful agent and an unset workflowEndState; preserve existing fixtures' semantics. Existing escalation regressions live in packages/nax/test/unit/metrics/tracker-escalation.test.ts:136. packages/nax/test/unit/pipeline/stages/completion-skip-persistence.test.ts:46 builds a real single-story completion context and :89 already parameterizes gate-open outcome reporting. Extend those existing tests to inspect ctx.storyMetrics[0].success without changing passed-state persistence expectations. tracker.test.ts already has 703 lines, so keep additions compact and follow test-size limits instead of creating unrelated files.

US-003 matching boundary and integration: packages/nax/src/prd/secret-shapes.ts:1 imports redactSecrets, :4 defines findings without kind, :10 exposes the old redactor seam, and :13 scans scoped story title, description, then acceptanceCriteria in array order. Replace only its detection implementation, preserve traversal/scope/nonmutation, add readonly kind, export the exact PROVIDER_SECRET_KINDS set, and remove _secretShapesDeps. Import SECRET_VALUE_PATTERNS through @nathapp/nax-agent/internal rather than a cross-package source path. packages/nax-agent/src/internal/redact.ts:36 defines SecretValuePattern including optional acceptMatch; :43 starts SECRET_VALUE_PATTERNS in priority order, with openai before github, aws at :51, PEM at :70, JWT at :75, and structured patterns interspersed. The only pattern with acceptMatch in this baseline is url-credentials (:118-122), which the provider allowlist excludes. Therefore the specified reset-lastIndex then re.test algorithm is appropriate for the selected kinds; do not run the structured pass, change patterns, or alter the shared logger redactor. Reset each selected regex before each field test and break after the first match so regex order, not textual position, determines kind. Global regex state is shared, making repeat-call tests important. The existing PRD barrel exports the finder and finding type at packages/nax/src/prd/index.ts:39-40; no new barrel export of the constant is required by the spec, whose tests import it from @/prd/secret-shapes.

US-003 persistence and testing: packages/nax/src/plan/strategies/persist-prd.ts:49 provides _persistPrdDeps, including findPrdSecretShapes at :58. finalizeAndWritePrd at :235 repairs/canonicalizes/finalizes before scanning finalized text with args.scope at :359. Replace its per-finding warn loop with a single conditional warning using count, ordered formatted fields, and distinct ascending kinds. Keep the scan catch at :362-365 unchanged: warn with no exception text/data and proceed to the write at :367, since failures may contain candidate text. Preserve routing/profile logs, transformation order, scoped behavior, outputPath return value, and original PRD story text. Tests are packages/nax/test/unit/prd/secret-shapes.test.ts:10 (field fixtures), :29 (order/scope/barrel behavior), and packages/nax/test/unit/plan/strategies/persist-prd-profile-log.test.ts:82 (advisory suite). Finder equality expectations need kind values, and advisory expectations need the exact plural message plus summary data. Remove the obsolete _secretShapesDeps import at :6 and redactor-throw case at :111; retain the _persistPrdDeps.findPrdSecretShapes throw case at :127 and its safe persistence guarantee. Use the exact fake provider-format values requested by the spec; never introduce real credentials. Although advisory-only, this touches token/credential detection, so US-003 uses three-session-tdd with strict test/implementation isolation. Its security risks are accidentally weakening log redaction, leaking matched text through metadata or errors, and retaining structured-only false positives. Tests must observe safe metadata, exact priority/order/count, repeated-call determinism, scope, silent structured-only plans, and persistence after scan failure.

Delivery and migration: all three stories can be implemented independently in existing files with existing interfaces; only CostRunSummary and PrdSecretShape gain fields, and the old finder-only seam is deleted. No database/schema migration, release/version bump, new dependencies, new cross-story seams, or generated context-file edits are required. Done means the specified unit-observable output and metrics corrections are present, old-record and unset-state compatibility is maintained, the single warning never contains matched text, and the explicitly excluded areas remain untouched.

Refine-pass audit against .nax/features/run-summary-followups/spec.md: all 30 numbered spec criteria are retained in their bound stories. Enumeration/mapping (spec criterion -> PRD criterion, one-based): US-001 1->1 (mapper positive count), 2->2 (legacy mapper default), 3->3 (positive Last Run field), 4->4 (zero omitted), 5->5 (legacy field omitted), 6->6 (positive Run Summary field), 7->7 (zero omitted), 8->8 (legacy field omitted). US-002 1->1 (gate-open success false), 2->2 (gate-open first-pass false without escalations/prior failures), 3->3 and 4 (complete success and first-pass true), 4->5 and 6 (complete-with-rulings success and first-pass true), 5->7 (unset end-state success compatibility), 6->8 (aggregate 0.5 from real collected metrics), 7->9 (completion stores success false). US-002 criterion 10 explicitly covers the failure table's unset-state first-pass compatibility and now defines its expected boolean from public context inputs rather than collector-local variable names. US-003 1->1 (api_key negative), 2->2 (TOKEN negative), 3->3 (Bearer negative), 4->4 (GitHub title/kind), 5->5 (fourth criterion/OpenAI kind), 6->6 (AWS), 7->7 (PEM), 8->8 (one finding and first-pattern OpenAI priority), 9->9 (US-002-only scope), 10->10 (one result on both consecutive calls), 11->11 (exact sorted allowlist), 12->12 (one exact summary warning), 13->13 (structured-only warning absent), 14->14 (no matched text in warning data), 15->15 and 16 (safe failure warning and persisted PRD). Compound spec assertions were split only to make individual outcomes independently testable. The first-pattern-order and global-lastIndex parentheticals remain attached to their findings; no deprecated file-content tags occur.

All four failure-table rows are covered: US-001 criteria 2/5 cover old metrics, US-001 criterion 8 covers old summary logs, US-002 criteria 7/10 cover unset workflow state, and US-003 criteria 15/16 cover a throwing scan with no warning data and continued persistence. Every story has a negative path: legacy/missing count inputs in US-001, gate-open exclusion in US-002, and structured-only negatives plus scanner failure in US-003. Regression anchors include omitted human-output keys for old/zero records, successful complete/complete-with-rulings and legacy end states, and unchanged persistence after advisory failure. Every criterion is observable through mapper/collector return values, captured logger calls, completion context state, or written PRD content; no quality gates are criteria.

Each story's five contextFiles exactly matches its five spec-recommended existing context files, with no newly created file listed. Existing-file-only scope, the three required story IDs, packages/nax workdirs, and empty dependency arrays remain unchanged. The five feature exclusions are retained verbatim in outOfScope and echoed near the relevant story boundaries. The descriptions retain the design algorithms and distinguish each story's implementation from its neighbors; examples in the warning design are illustrative metadata, while US-003 criterion 12 defines the exact GitHub/OpenAI fixture result. No change to shared redaction or historical metrics is proposed. Routing remains the lightest realistic choice: medium/tdd-simple for three additive view/mapper edits, simple/tdd-simple for one predicate module, and medium/three-session-tdd for the two-module credential-detection change under the mandatory security override. No dependencies, new helpers, new files, or additional unsupported feature requirements were introduced by the audit.
outOfScope: The batch story-metrics path (`collectBatchMetrics`, `success: true` for every batch story) is not changed: batching is pipeline mode only (`workflowStage` throws `WORKFLOW_BATCH_UNREACHABLE` on a batch), and pipeline mode is frozen.
Gate-open is not added to `nax status` feature views, `nax runs list`, or the aggregate `CostAggregate`; #2885 names only `nax status --cost` last-run and `nax runs show`.
